chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Ibrahim ibn Nu'aym al-Azdi, who said:

I asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام about four who testified against a man for zina, then after he was killed, one of them retracted his testimony. He said: So he said, "The one who retracts is killed, and the other three shall pay to his family three-quarters of the diyah."

key_terms.الدِّيَةِ: blood money payable as legal compensation
key_terms.الرَّاجِعُ: the one who retracts his testimony
key_terms.الزِّنَى: illicit sexual intercourse requiring specific legal testimony

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if one witness retracts after four witnesses testified to zina and the accused was executed?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning false or retracted testimony in a capital case of zina. It states that if four witnesses testified and the accused was killed, then one witness later retracts, the retracting witness is subject to execution, while the remaining three must pay three-quarters of the diyah to the victim's family.
